probes.name: ascending
probes.source:
10 FOR I=1 TO 5 STEP 2
20 PRINT I
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

probes.name: descending variable step
probes.source:
10 S=-2
15 FOR I=5 TO 1 STEP S
20 PRINT I
25 S=3
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

probes.name: ascending loop with descending bounds
probes.source:
10 FOR I=5 TO 1 STEP 2
20 PRINT I
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

probes.name: descending loop with ascending bounds
probes.source:
10 FOR I=1 TO 5 STEP -2
20 PRINT I
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

probes.name: descending half-step
probes.source:
10 FOR I=3 TO 1 STEP -.5
20 PRINT I
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

probes.name: rounded quotient
probes.source:
10 FOR I=0 TO 1 STEP 1/3
20 PRINT I
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

probes.name: rounded descending quotient
probes.source:
10 FOR I=1 TO 0 STEP -(1/3)
20 PRINT I
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

probes.name: loop variable assignment
probes.source:
10 FOR I=1 TO 7 STEP 2
20 PRINT I
25 I=I+1
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END

zeroStepProbe.source:
10 FOR I=1 TO 1 STEP 0
20 PRINT I
25 J=J+1
26 IF J=3 THEN 40
30 NEXT I
40 PRINT I
50 END
